dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Yeah... And since we burn through muskets really quickly on the field, we need to choose models that we have the parts to maintain — especially on long expeditions.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: While 5th Coy has its own ranged weapons, we don't have a stable source for them in Nod-Krai... which is why we also procure generic models manufactured elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Captain Lohen always says that weapons are just like methods... anything goes, so long as it achieves the goal. If it doesn't feel right, it just means you haven't practiced enough with it.
